### Reading the list above (18 Nov 2026)
- **Not reachable in production** (mounted only when `NODE_ENV !== 'production'`): `/api/auth/debug-*`, `/api/auth/test-*`,
  `/api/auth/user-table-schema`, `/api/debug*`, `/api/debug-email`, `/api/dev/*`, `/api/migrate/*`. Recommended: remove
  them before launch (audit S9); a test proving they 404 in production mode is still missing.
- **Removed since the audit:** `/api/admin/gocardless`, `/api/payments/capabilities` (GoCardless).
- **Provider-dependent (pending setup):** `/api/payments/stripe/checkout-session`, `/api/billing/payment-methods/complete-setup`,
  `/api/kyc/sync-from-sumsub`, `/api/kyc/upload-documents`, `/api/webhooks/onedrive`, `/api/companies-house/company/:number`.
- **Customer features with no automated test yet:** Companies House proof upload (`/api/profile/ch-verification`), mail tag/restore,
  tag merge/delete, notifications mark-read, GDPR export, file signed URLs, bulk forwarding requests, quiz submit/stats,
  support info. These are working-assumed, not proven.
- **Admin features with no automated test yet:** blog upload, forwarding complete/lock status, send password reset, mail audit,
  repair (FTS/backfill), internal billing jobs, ops self-test/heartbeat, metrics.

## Removed screens: required functionality check
| Removed | What it did | Where that is now |
|---|---|---|
| In-page BillingDashboard (`/#billing`) | Plan, invoices, manage subscription | `/account/billing` (plan, payment, invoices, Stripe portal) |
| In-page KYCDashboard | Start/see identity check | `/account/verification` (status steps, Sumsub start, owners) |
| In-page ProfilePage | Name, phone, password | `/account/settings` |
| Admin BillingSection | Transactions, refunds | Called `/api/admin/transactions*`, which never existed. Refunds are Stripe work (decision 17; outstanding provider work) |
| Admin OverviewSection, AnalyticsSection, SettingsSection | Stats, analytics, settings, backups | Not mounted; called endpoints that never existed. Counts now in the admin sidebar; system page is a proposed new item |
| Admin UserEditForm | Edit/suspend/activate a user | Edit modal in Users; suspend/restore/close in the standing dialog (audited) |
| Admin ConcurrencySafeForwardingTable | Forwarding with locks | Not mounted; forwarding board uses the lock endpoints |
No required customer or admin feature was lost; the removed admin screens were not reachable from the dashboard.
